description:
Dating back to the mid-1800s, this sympathetically converted detached barn offers a unique living experience over three floors. The property retains its period charm and character, with an interesting layout that includes three bedrooms, a study area, a bathroom, and a shower room. The spacious living dining room leads into a well-appointed kitchen, perfect for family gatherings or entertaining guests.

Outside, a mature private garden with a raised decking area provides a peaceful retreat, while ample parking, a garage, and a utility room offer convenience and practicality. This property also presents an opportunity for multi-generational living, making it ideal for families seeking versatile living spaces.

Located in a sought-after village with easy access to the M6 at Junction 43 and the A69, this residence is also close to Carlisle golf club, providing a convenient location for golf enthusiasts. With amenities such as a regular bus service, Indian restaurant, pub in nearby Scotby village, and a Tesco superstore, this property offers a perfect balance of tranquillity and accessibility.

Directions From Carlisle follow Warwick Road, heading over the M6 on the A69 towards Newcastle. 1/4 mile after the end of the dual carriage way take the first turning to the left into the village. Follow this road and Manor Barn is on the right hand side after approximately 250 metres.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
